sources_used.source: Downtown Metuchen business directory (MDA/chamber member directory) - category pages
NJ Business Directory - Metuchen listings (4 pages)
BestProsInTown Metuchen city and category pages (hair, barbers, nails, beauty, chiropractors, massage, acupuncture, vets, accountants)
Bing Maps local search (accountant, attorney, insurance agency, real estate brokerage)
WebMD provider directory - Metuchen internal medicine
Healthgrades Metuchen dentist and psychiatry directories
Web search results (category + Metuchen NJ queries, ~20 queries)

categories_thin: Title and appraisal: only River Edge Title and Wade Appraisal surfaced for Metuchen addresses
Staffing: 3-4 firms only; most employment agencies in the area are in Edison
Optometry: only Metuchen Vision has a Metuchen-address independent practice; the other nearby option is a Pearle Vision-branded doctor group
Real estate brokerage: most Metuchen-address offices are franchises (Weichert, Coldwell Banker, BHHS, Keller Williams, RE/MAX) and were excluded by rule
Surveying: only one firm (Landmark Surveys) found; surveying firms in the area are mostly in Edison/Woodbridge
caveats: Google Maps returned only a limited 5-result view from this environment; Bing Maps, chamber and third-party directories were used to compensate, so small offices may still be undercounted.
Yellow Pages, Yelp, Superpages, Manta, ChamberofCommerce.com and Cylex all returned HTTP 403 to direct fetches; a few listings come only from search-result snippets and are flagged in notes.
Overpass/OpenStreetMap API was unreachable, so no OSM cross-check of office/health POIs was possible.
Several directories file Edison or Woodbridge businesses under a 'Metuchen' label; only entries with an explicit Metuchen address (or Metuchen-specific practice page) were kept.
Solo practitioners (therapists, physicians, CPAs) are included as independent businesses; several list only a suite or no street address and are marked Unknown.

Franchise/brand and large-system locations (Massage Envy, Supercuts, Merle Norman, Club Pilates, StretchLab, Banfield, UPS Store, Edward Jones, State Farm/Farmers agent offices, hospital PT departments, Kessler) were excluded except two PT entries kept and flagged for the triage team.
data_gaps: No municipal business license or registry list is published by Metuchen borough, so there is no authoritative denominator for completeness.
The Metuchen Area Chamber of Commerce member directory exists only as a print/PDF community guide (Townsquare Publications); chamber-only members outside the downtown district may be missing.
Many dentist and physician entries from ranking/provider directories lack street addresses; they need triage confirmation.
Shared-suite addresses (406 Main St rooms, 267 Amboy Ave, 16 Pearl St, 61 Pearl St) create duplicate risk; the triage team should merge by practice.
Online-only therapists listed under Metuchen on Psychology Today (no Metuchen office) were skipped.
